svg.title: Use Case: Add a Certificate to a Trust Store

g.text: Use Case: Add a Certificate to a Trust Store
Planned: AddCertificateToTrustStoreWithCrl, CRL propagation from the source
The trust store writes only exclusive-mutable slots. Shared-static and
conditional-external slots are managed through the slot APIs. Removing a
member clears only an exclusive slot; enable, disable, and acknowledge
are separate operations. A failed write to an empty exclusive slot rolls
back by clearing the slot and invalidating its caches.
